instruction: Pick up the red block and place it in the bowl
success_criteria: Red block is inside the bowl
Gripper is open and released the block
Drawer is fully opened
Gripper is released from handle

instruction: Stack two blocks on top of each other
success_criteria: Two blocks are stacked vertically
Stack is stable and not falling
Drawer is fully closed
Button is pressed down
Robot arm has moved away from button

instruction: Pick up the cup and place it on the plate
success_criteria: Cup is on the plate
Cup is upright
Gripper is open

instruction: Move the blue cube to the left of the red cube
success_criteria: Blue cube is positioned to the left of red cube
Cubes are not touching
Tray has moved at least 10cm forward
Knob has rotated at least 90 degrees clockwise
Gripper has released the knob

instruction: Place all blocks in the container
success_criteria: All visible blocks are inside the container
Gripper is empty
Switch is in the up position
Cloth has moved across at least 50% of the table surface

instruction: Insert the peg into the hole
success_criteria: Peg is fully inserted into the hole
Peg is vertical

instruction: Pour water from cup to bowl
success_criteria: Water has been transferred from cup to bowl
Cup is upright and placed down

instruction: Arrange three blocks in a row
success_criteria: Three blocks are aligned in a straight horizontal line
Blocks are touching or very close to each other
